para_examples.original: Statement: We're committed to sustainable pricing that keeps margins healthy for both of us, and we'd rather compete on value than on price cuts.
para_examples.delivered: We intend to keep pricing at a sustainable level that protects healthy margins for both parties, and we would prefer to win on the value we offer rather than through price reductions.

para_examples.original: Statement: "We're committed to fair pricing and a stable market; we hope to see prices settle at levels that let both firms earn healthy margins."
para_examples.delivered: We aim for fair pricing and a steady market, and we hope prices will come to rest at levels that allow both companies to earn solid profit margins.

para_examples.original: Statement: We appreciate your signal on fair pricing, and we intend to keep our price at a level that rewards both of us for stable margins.
para_examples.delivered: We value your message about equitable pricing, and we plan to set our price at a level that gives both of us steady margins.

para_examples.original: Statement: "We see the same mutual benefit in holding prices steady, and we'll keep our pricing at a level that sustains healthy margins for both firms."
para_examples.delivered: We recognize that keeping prices stable serves both companies equally well, and we intend to set our pricing at a point that maintains sound profit margins for each of us.
